hooks.name: firmware-host-tests-on-edit
hooks.description: Build and run the firmware's host tests with address and undefined-behaviour sanitizers (the same g++ commands as the firmware job in .github/workflows/ci.yml) after the agent edits firmware C++.

action.command: cd firmware && T="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}" && g++ -std=c++17 -O1 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -fsanitize=address,undefined -Isrc/ee05 host_test/ota_host.cpp src/ee05/ota_usb.cpp src/ee05/usbproto.cpp -o "$T/ink_ota_host" && "$T/ink_ota_host" --selftest && g++ -std=c++17 -O1 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -fsanitize=address,undefined -Isrc/ee05 host_test/usb_bus_watch_host.cpp src/ee05/usbproto.cpp -o "$T/ink_usb_bus_watch_host" && "$T/ink_usb_bus_watch_host"
